Application Data.NAME: StitchCraft Tailoring Co.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: StitchCraft Tailoring Co. specializes in custom tailoring and alterations for a diverse clientele, offering services such as dressmaking, suit alterations, and garment repairs. We prioritize quality craftsmanship and customer satisfaction, employing skilled tailors with attention to detail. Our operations involve secure handling of customer garments, with robust inventory management practices in place to mitigate risks of loss or damage. We maintain a secure premises equipped with fire safety measures and regularly audited equipment to minimize operational risks. Additionally, we uphold strict employee screening processes to prevent theft and ensure a trustworthy team. Our commitment to data privacy includes safeguarding customer information in our database, reflecting our proactive approach to mitigating cyber risks.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On April 15, 2023, StitchCraft Tailoring Co. experienced a theft incident in which an employee stole high-end designer fabrics valued at $2,000. The loss was discovered during an inventory audit, and the matter was reported to law enforcement. The status of the claim is currently pending, and measures have been implemented to strengthen employee screening processes to prevent future occurrences.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B, Grade II, UL Listed
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing installed around the perimeter of the premises, along with night watchpersons monitoring the facility after hours.
